description: Curated, living catalogs of open government datasets across climate & energy and economy & small business, harvested from data.gov (US), data.gov.uk (UK), Socrata, Zenodo, Hugging Face, EIA, FRED, and national CKAN portals (Canada, Australia, Argentina, Mexico). Every entry is license-verified (US public domain, public domain, CC0, CC-BY, UK Open Government Licence v3.0, Open Government Licence – Canada family) before publication. Provided as CSV and JSON, one row per dataset. Underlying datasets retain their own licenses — see LICENSES.md for attribution requirements.
title: GovDataHub — Open Government Dataset Catalogs
